statements.statement: SELECT hex(PollK) AS PollK FROM TPoll LIMIT 1
SELECT hex(PollK) id, FName name, FHeader header FROM TPoll {?? exists( args::exists( args, "name" ), "WHERE FName LIKE ''%{=name}%'' OR FHeader LIKE ''%{=name}%''" ) ??} ORDER BY FName
SELECT PollK, FName, FHeader, FDescription FROM TPoll WHERE PollK = x{PollK}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS uCount FROM TPoll WHERE PollK = {PollK}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS uCount FROM TPollQuestion WHERE PollK = X{PollK}
SELECT hex(PollK) AS PollK, TypeC, StateC, FName, FHeader, FDescription FROM TPoll WHERE PollK = X{PollK}
SELECT hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FName, FLabel, FDescription FROM TPollQuestion WHERE PollK = X{PollK}
SELECT hex(PollAnswerK) AS PollAnswerK, hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FName, FLabel, FDescription FROM TPollAnswer WHERE PollK = X{PollK}

SELECT hex(TPoll.PollK) AS PollK, hex(TPollQuestion.PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, hex(TPollAnswer.PollAnswerK) AS PollAnswerK, TPollQuestion.FName AS Q_FName, TPollQuestion.FLabel AS Q_FLabel, TPollQuestion.FDescription AS Q_FDescription, TPollQuestion.FOrder AS Q_FOrder, TPollAnswer.FName AS A_FName, TPollAnswer.FAnswer AS A_FAnswer, TPollAnswer.FOrder AS A_FOrder, TPollAnswer.FDescription AS A_Description FROM TPoll LEFT JOIN TPollQuestion ON TPoll.PollK = TPollQuestion.PollK LEFT JOIN TPollAnswer ON TPollQuestion.PollQuestionK = TPollAnswer.PollQuestionK WHERE TPoll.PollK = X{PollK} ORDER BY 1,TPollQuestion.FOrder, 2,TPollAnswer.FOrder

SELECT hex(UserK) id, FAlias alias, FFirstName name, FLastName lastname FROM TUser {?? exists( args::exists( args, "name" ), "WHERE FAlias LIKE ''%{=name}%'' OR FFirstName LIKE ''%{=name}%'' OR FLastName LIKE ''%{=name}%''" ) ??} ORDER BY FAlias
SELECT FAlias, FFirstName, FLastName, FMail, FPassword, FDisplayName, FLoginName FROM TUser WHERE UserK = x{UserK}
{ "table": "PollK;FName,Name;FHeader,Header;FDescription,Description" } SELECT hex(PollK) AS PollK, FName, FHeader, FDescription FROM TPoll WHERE PollK = X{PollK}

{ "table": "PollQuestionK;FLabel;FName,Name;FQuestion,Question;FQuestionMore,More;FDescription,Description" } SELECT hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FLabel, FName, FQuestion, FQuestionMore, FDescription FROM TPollQuestion WHERE PollK = X{PollK} ORDER BY FOrder
SELECT hex(PollAnswerK) AS PollAnswerK, hex(PollQuestionK) AS PollQuestionK, FName, FAnswer FROM TPollAnswer WHERE PollK = X{PollK}

-- #lua v1; -- ## Check if voter can vote function check_vote(sBinaryIp, sPollK) local sqlCheck = doc:CreateSql() sqlCheck:AddColumn({name = "PollTieK", alias = "count_vote", raw = "COUNT(*)"}) sqlCheck:AddCondition({name = "FIp", value = sBinaryIp, type = "binary"}) sqlCheck:AddCondition({name = "PollK", value = sPollK, type = "binary"}) local sSelectCheck = sqlCheck:AsSelect({ table = "TPollTie" }); local database = request:GetDatabase() local iVoteCount = tonumber( database:Ask(sSelectCheck) ) -- print("Vote count for this IP: " .. iVoteCount) if iVoteCount > 0 then return false end return true end
local expression = Expression:new(); local sIp = request:GetIpAddress() -- Get user IP address local sBinaryIp = expression:Calculate( [[str::ip_format(ip, "hex", 32 )]], { ip = sIp } ) -- Convert IP address to binary local sPollK = request:GetSqlValue("PollK") print("GetSqlValue PollK: " .. sPollK)
local bCanVote = check_vote(sBinaryIp, sPollK) -- Check if user can vote if not bCanVote then print("User has already voted, aborting.") -- @TODO [description: add message to body and set to abort] return end
-- ## Insert vote into TPollTie to tie votes together local database = request:GetDatabase() local sql = request:CreateSql() sql:AddColumn({name = "FIp", value = sBinaryIp, type = "binary"}) sql:SetColumn( "PollK", {type = "binary"}) local sInsert = sql:AsInsert({ table = "TPollTie", returning = "PollTieK" }) -- print("SQL - INSERT to TPollTie : " .. sInsert) local sKey = database:ExecuteReturn(sInsert); -- print("Tie key: " .. sKey) request:SetGlobalVariable("FTie", sKey)
